prose:
A Techmeme excerpt of Financial Times reporting says AI server suppliers including Dell, HPE, Lenovo and Supermicro are demanding substantially higher prices from buyers, months after contracts were signed, with the increased costs hitting trading firms among others. The primary article could not be retrieved in this pass, so the size of the increases, the contractual mechanisms invoked and which buyers are affected could not be inspected beyond the excerpt.

A sourced pricing report describes what suppliers are demanding, not what buyers will ultimately pay after negotiation or litigation. Demands made months after signing raise contract questions the excerpt does not answer, and the sourcing behind the report remains unverified here.
highlights: Primary source inaccessible; summary rests on the indexed excerpt
Four named server suppliers reported to be demanding higher prices
Demands reportedly come months after contracts were signed
Demands are not settled prices; outcomes of renegotiation unknown
